meta.method: WebSearch only; WebFetch was blocked for every vendor help host in this session (intacct.com, learn.microsoft.com, help-sage50.na.sage.com, developer.xero.com, cdn.cdata.com), so full help pages could not be opened. Each entry has a 'verified' list (backed by search-result snippets from vendor or community pages) and an 'inferred' list (from product knowledge or typical exports, not confirmed in this session). Before hard-coding a parser, check every layout against a real sample export.
meta.parser_guidance: Every product puts 2-6 title rows above the column header. Find the header row by matching debit/credit keywords rather than using a fixed row offset. Total rows begin with 'Total' or 'TOTAL'. Amounts arrive as numbers in XLSX, but in CSV they may be strings with thousands separators, so strip ',', '$' and '(...)'.

formats.file_type: XLSX (Export to Excel), PDF; CSV is offered in the newer 'modern' report view
header_rows: Row 1: Company name (e.g. 'Craig's Design and Landscaping Services')
formats.account_display: With account numbers off (the default), the account name only, e.g. 'Checking'. Sub-accounts appear as 'Parent:Child', e.g. 'Utilities:Gas and Electric'. With account numbers on (Settings > Advanced > Chart of accounts), the number is prefixed to the name in the same cell, e.g. '1000 Checking'. There is no separate number column.
formats.numbering_scheme: The default QBO chart of accounts has no account numbers. Users who turn numbering on usually adopt a 4- or 5-digit scheme: 1xxx assets, 2xxx liabilities, 3xxx equity, 4xxx income, 5xxx COGS, 6xxx-7xxx expenses, 8xxx-9xxx other income and expense.
formats.total_row: 'TOTAL' in column A, with equal debit and credit totals
formats.footer: Last row (separated by a blank row) holds the basis and a timestamp, e.g. 'Accrual Basis Monday, November 24, 2025 10:15 AM GMT-08:00'. In the classic export this footer sits in the sheet body.
formats.number_format: Numeric cells with 2 decimals and thousands separators, no currency symbol in the Excel cells (the PDF shows '$'). Each account fills only one side, debit or credit. Zero-balance accounts are hidden by default.
formats.comparative_columns: No native prior-year or comparative columns. 'Display columns by' (months, quarters, years) exists in the older view but is limited. Intuit staff say to export each period and combine the files in Excel.

Centered: company name, 'Trial Balance', 'As of December 31, 2025'

columns: (blank, holds account; Excel may add empty spacer/indent columns)
formats.account_display: Number, a space, a middle dot (U+00B7), a space, then the name, e.g. '10100 · Checking'. Sub-accounts carry the full path, e.g. '60000 · Utilities:60100 · Gas and Electric'. Number and name share one cell, and there is no built-in option to split them.
formats.numbering_scheme: Account numbers are optional (Preferences > Accounting > Use account numbers). Intuit sample companies and many industry templates use 5 digits: 10000-19999 assets (10100 Checking, 11000 Accounts Receivable, 12000 Undeposited Funds, 12100 Inventory Asset), 20000-29999 liabilities (20000 Accounts Payable), 30000-39999 equity (30000 Opening Balance Equity, 32000 Owner's/Retained Earnings), 40000s income, 50000s COGS, 60000s expenses, 70000s-80000s other income and expense.
formats.footer: None in the sheet body. The 'Page x of y' footer goes to Excel Page Setup.
formats.number_format: Numeric cells with 2 decimals and thousands separators. A side with no balance is blank, not 0. Debit and credit columns cannot be set to show signed amounts.
formats.comparative_columns: No comparative columns in the standard report. Accountant and Enterprise Accountant editions include the Working Trial Balance (Accountant Center), which has beginning balance, transactions, adjustments and ending balance, but it is a separate tool. 'Display columns by' Class is available ('Trial Balance by Class').

Report 4405: an Excel workbook (Business Central 2024 wave 1 and later) with a parameters/filters sheet and a data sheet ('TrialBalanceData'), plus a formatted sheet in local currency (and additional reporting currency)
columns: Report 6: 'No.', 'Name', 'Net Change' (Debit, Credit), 'Balance' (Debit, Credit), i.e. 6 columns: No. | Name | Net Change Debit | Net Change Credit | Balance Debit | Balance Credit
